title: एकोनविंशतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks the meaning of the words said at the marriage that the wife shares in dharma. Bhishma answers by telling of the sage Ashtavakra, who asked for the hand of the daughter of the sage Vadanya, and was told to go to the north to see what was there before his marriage.
summary.kn: ವಿವಾಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಪತ್ನಿ ಧರ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೊತೆಗಾರ್ತಿ ಎಂಬ ಮಾತಿನ ಅರ್ಥವೇನೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಋಷಿ ವದಾನ್ಯನ ಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದ ಅಷ್ಟಾವಕ್ರ ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಉತ್ತರ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲಿರುವುದನ್ನು ನೋಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ಹೇಳಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि विवाह में पत्नी के धर्म की सहभागी होने का क्या अर्थ है। भीष्म ऋषि अष्टावक्र की कथा कहते हैं जिन्होंने ऋषि वदान्य की पुत्री का हाथ माँगा और जिन्हें विवाह से पहले उत्तर दिशा जाकर वहाँ जो है उसे देखने को कहा गया।
summary.te: వివాహంలో భార్య ధర్మంలో సహభాగిని అనే మాటకు అర్థమేమిటని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. ఋషి వదాన్యుని కూతురును కోరిన అష్టావక్రుడు వివాహానికి ముందు ఉత్తర దిశకు వెళ్లి అక్కడున్నదాన్ని చూడాలని చెప్పబడిన కథను భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: திருமணத்தில் மனைவி தர்மத்தில் துணை என்று சொல்லப்படுவதன் பொருள் என்ன என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, முனிவர் வதான்யரின் மகளைக் கேட்ட அஷ்டாவக்கிரர் மணத்துக்கு முன் வடக்கே சென்று அங்குள்ளதைக் காண வேண்டும் என்று கூறப்பட்ட கதையைப் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: വിവാഹവേളയിൽ ഭാര്യ ധർമ്മത്തിൽ പങ്കുചേരുന്നു എന്ന വാക്കിന്റെ അർത്ഥം യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. വദാന്യന്റെ മകളെ വിവാഹത്തിന് ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ട അഷ്ടാവക്രനോട്, വിവാഹത്തിനുമുമ്പ് വടക്കുദിക്കിൽ ചെന്ന് അവിടെയുള്ളത് കാണണമെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞ കഥ ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.19; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
यदिदं सहधर्मेति प्रोच्यते भरतर्षभ ।
पाणिग्रहणकाले तु स्त्रीणामेतत्कथं स्मृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Best of the Bharatas, this saying 'together in dharma' is spoken at the time of taking the bride's hand. How is it remembered as applying to women?

verses.text:
आर्ष एष भवेद्धर्मः प्राजापत्योऽथ वासुरः ।
यदेतत्सहधर्मेति पूर्वमुक्तं महर्षिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Whether the marriage be of the Arsha, the Prajapatya or the Asura kind, this phrase 'together in dharma' was stated of old by the great sages.

verses.text:
संदेहः सुमहानेष विरुद्ध इति मे मतिः ।
इह यः सहधर्मो वै प्रेत्यायं विहितः क्व नु ॥

meaning.en: I think this is a very great doubt and a contradiction. Where, after death, is this 'together in dharma' ordained?

verses.text:
स्वर्गे मृतानां भवति सहधर्मः पितामह ।
पूर्वमेकस्तु म्रियते क्व चैकस्तिष्ठते वद ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, the shared dharma of the dead applies in heaven; but when one dies first, where does the other remain? Tell me.

verses.text:
नानाकर्मफलोपेता नानाकर्मनिवासिनः ।
नानानिरयनिष्ठान्ता मानुषा बहवो यदा ॥

meaning.en: People are bound with fruits of many kinds of action, dwell in many works, and end in many hells, as so many humans do.

verses.text:
अनृताः स्त्रिय इत्येवं सूत्रकारो व्यवस्यति ।
यदानृताः स्त्रियस्तात सहधर्मः कुतः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: The author of the Sutra settles that women are untruthful. If women are untruthful, father, how is a shared dharma remembered?

verses.text:
अनृताः स्त्रिय इत्येवं वेदेष्वपि हि पठ्यते ।
धर्मोऽयं पौर्विकी संज्ञा उपचारः क्रियाविधिः ॥

meaning.en: It is read even in the Vedas that women are untruthful. This is dharma by an old designation, a courtesy and a ritual rule.

verses.text:
गह्वरं प्रतिभात्येतन्मम चिन्तयतोऽनिशम् ।
निःसंदेहमिदं सर्वं पितामह यथा श्रुतिः ॥

meaning.en: This seems to me a deep thicket as I think on it ceaselessly. Grandfather, all of this is beyond doubt as the Shruti says.

verses.text:
यदेतद्यादृशं चैतद्यथा चैतत्प्रवर्तितम् ।
निखिलेन महाप्राज्ञ भवानेतद्ब्रवीतु मे ॥

meaning.en: Great sage, please explain to me fully what this is, of what kind, and how it came to be established.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
अष्टावक्रस्य संवादं दिशया सह भारत ॥

meaning.en: On this they cite an ancient tale, the dialogue of Ashtavakra with the Direction, Bharata.

verses.text:
निवेष्टुकामस्तु पुरा अष्टावक्रो महातपाः ।
ऋषेरथ वदान्यस्य कन्यां वव्रे महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Long ago the great ascetic Ashtavakra, wishing to marry, asked for the daughter of the generous, great-souled sage Vadanya.

verses.text:
सुप्रभां नाम वै नाम्ना रूपेणाप्रतिमां भुवि ।
गुणप्रबर्हां शीलेन साध्वीं चारित्रशोभनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Her name was Suprabha, peerless on earth in beauty, outstanding in virtues, virtuous in character and adorned with good conduct.

verses.text:
सा तस्य दृष्ट्वैव मनो जहार शुभलोचना ।
वनराजी यथा चित्रा वसन्ते कुसुमाचिता ॥

meaning.en: Fair-eyed, she captured his mind at a glance, like a forest row blooming with spring flowers in many colors.

verses.text:
ऋषिस्तमाह देया मे सुता तुभ्यं शृणुष्व मे ।
गच्छ तावद्दिशं पुण्यामुत्तरां द्रक्ष्यसे ततः ॥

meaning.en: The sage said to him, 'I will give you my daughter; listen to me. First go to the holy northern direction; then you will see.'

verses.text: अष्टावक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Ashtavakra said:

verses.text:
किं द्रष्टव्यं मया तत्र वक्तुमर्हति मे भवान् ।
तथेदानीं मया कार्यं यथा वक्ष्यति मां भवान् ॥

meaning.en: What should I see there? You should tell me. And I shall do just as you tell me.

verses.text: वदान्य उवाच

meaning.en: Vadanya said:

verses.text:
धनदं समतिक्रम्य हिमवन्तं तथैव च ।
रुद्रस्यायतनं दृष्ट्वा सिद्धचारणसेवितम् ॥

meaning.en: Passing Kubera's realm and the Himalaya, you will see Rudra's abode, frequented by siddhas and charanas,

verses.text:
प्रहृष्टैः पार्षदैर्जुष्टं नृत्यद्भिर्विविधाननैः ।
दिव्याङ्गरागैः पैशाचैर्वन्यैर्नानाविधैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: filled with joyful attendants dancing with many faces, with divine ointments, and with forest pishachas of many kinds.

verses.text:
पाणितालसतालैश्च शम्यातालैः समैस्तथा ।
संप्रहृष्टैः प्रनृत्यद्भिः शर्वस्तत्र निषेव्यते ॥

meaning.en: Shiva is served there by gleeful dancers who clap hands, cymbals and shami-wood time-beats in rhythm.

verses.text:
इष्टं किल गिरौ स्थानं तद्दिव्यमनुशुश्रुम ।
नित्यं संनिहितो देवस्तथा पारिषदाः शुभाः ॥

meaning.en: We have heard that the mountain place is dear to him and divine; the God and his fine attendants are always present.

verses.text:
तत्र देव्या तपस्तप्तं शंकरार्थं सुदुश्चरम् ।
अतस्तदिष्टं देवस्य तथोमाया इति श्रुतिः ॥

meaning.en: There the Goddess performed a very hard austerity for Shankara's sake; so, tradition says, that place is dear to the God and to Uma.

verses.text:
तत्र कूपो महान्पार्श्वे देवस्योत्तरतस्तथा ।
ऋतवः कालरात्रिश्च ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः ॥

meaning.en: There is a great well beside the God, to his north. The seasons and the dark night, divine and human alike,

verses.text:
सर्वे देवमुपासन्ते रूपिणः किल तत्र ह ।
तदतिक्रम्य भवनं त्वया यातव्यमेव हि ॥

meaning.en: all attend the God there in bodily form. Passing beyond that dwelling, you must go on.

verses.text:
ततो नीलं वनोद्देशं द्रक्ष्यसे मेघसंनिभम् ।
रमणीयं मनोग्राहि तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि वै स्त्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: Then you will see a blue, cloud-like stretch of forest, lovely and mind-capturing, and there you will see a woman.

verses.text:
तपस्विनीं महाभागां वृद्धां दीक्षामनुष्ठिताम् ।
द्रष्टव्या सा त्वया तत्र संपूज्या चैव यत्नतः ॥

meaning.en: She is a fortunate ascetic, old and under a vow of consecration. You must see her there and respect her with care.

verses.text:
तां दृष्ट्वा विनिवृत्तस्त्वं ततः पाणिं ग्रहीष्यसि ।
यद्येष समयः सत्यः साध्यतां तत्र गम्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: After seeing her you will turn back, and then you will take my daughter's hand. If this condition is acceptable, go there and accomplish it.
